question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` become the supported public Plugin SDK subtype for transient tool notices?
rationale: Typed intent avoids unsafe Slack text inference, but it expands a permanent public plugin API beside existing status-notice and fast-mode semantics, so the long-term taxonomy requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve generic subtype
options.body: Keep the additive kind and predicate, then require redacted exact-current-head Codex-to-Slack lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate taxonomy
options.body: Pause this PR and define one closed notice-kind model across transient status and progress producers before changing Slack.

recommendation.title: Approve generic subtype
recommendation.body: Keep the additive kind and predicate, then require redacted exact-current-head Codex-to-Slack lifecycle proof before merge.
